domain: finite-dimensional vector spaces over GF(2); indexed subspace occurrences; two geometric classes U and W; multiplicities a,b >= 1

symbolic_proof_plan.lower_bound_U: If a>=2, the first and last U-occurrence positions determine an internal cut with a U-occurrence on each side. Hence both side spans contain U, their intersection contains U, and layout width is at least p.
symbolic_proof_plan.lower_bound_W: If b>=2, symmetrically every layout has width at least q.
symbolic_proof_plan.single_single_lower_upper: If a=b=1, the unique internal cut is U | W and has width r.
symbolic_proof_plan.grouped_upper_bound: Use the grouped layout U^a W^b. Cuts internal to the U block have width p when a>=2; the U/W boundary has width r; cuts internal to the W block have width q when b>=2. Since r<=p and r<=q, the grouped maximum is exactly the candidate formula.
symbolic_proof_plan.indexed_occurrence_rule: Multiplicity is over distinct input occurrence identities even when geometric subspaces are equal.

proof_requirements: symbolic derivation independent of exhaustive controls
exhaustive all-subspace-pair controls for ambient dimensions 0..4
all class-pattern layouts replayed; indexed multiplicity counted separately
conformance with frozen B5.2B cut-width definition
literature novelty audit before NEW_RESULT promotion
